item.title: Chicago arts organizations seek funding increase at state hearing
item.description: <p>Leaders of Illinois’ top cultural organizations advocated for more state funding amid economic headwinds at a state hearing on Tuesday.</p><p>Those leaders were summoned by Rep. Kimberly Du Buclet, D-Chicago, chair of the Illinois House Committee on Museums, Arts, Culture and Entertainment, for a hearing at the Michael A. Bilandic Building in the Loop. A series of panels addressed committee members on the economic impact of arts and culture organizations and the outlook for the sector.</p><p>
